title: Path of Awakening
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji opened his eyes, he sensed a gaze upon him—not from the Tianji Eye, but from a higher existence. Mo Xiansheng's warning echoed in his ears: 'It has awakened.'

text.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped into that void, a vast consciousness like a galaxy enveloped him. It was not oppressive, but rather a scrutiny beyond comprehension—as if the entire heavens were intently observing this ant-like existence, wondering if it truly carried the hope to break the chess game.

dialogue.content: 'Ten thousand years.' For the first time, that ancient voice carried a complex emotion. 'I have waited for this day, waited a full twelve thousand years.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt a warm force surge from the void into his body, resonating with the dormant Tianji Record Fragment in his bloodline. Agonizing pain and profound relief intertwined, as countless memories flooded his Mental Sea—the life of that ancient being twelve thousand years prior, the harrowing lessons of its march toward annihilation.

Within the torrent of memories, Chen Ji witnessed that being's final moment: it chose not to flee, but to proactively transform itself into a chess piece, embedded within the Heavenly Secrets Eye's grand design. Across ten millennia, it had slumbered in fragmented form, awaiting a variable capable of shattering the cycle of reincarnation.

choice.prompt: In the torrent of inheritance, Chen Ji must make a critical choice, which will determine the degree of his fusion with this power.

choices.description: Completely open your spiritual consciousness, accepting the entire inheritance and memories of that twelve-thousand-year-old existence.
choices.visible_cost: Spiritual consciousness may be impacted, potentially causing brief loss of self
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete inheritance, breakthrough to Heavenly Secrets realm
choices.risk_hint: High risk, high reward; may become lost in ten thousand years of memories

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, opening his spiritual consciousness wide, allowing the torrent to wash over his Mental Sea. Ten thousand years of memories surged like a tide. He witnessed countless possible futures, and the dying determination of that existence—to shatter this endless cycle.

choices.description: Maintain spiritual consciousness clarity, only selectively absorbing core inheritance related to the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Inheritance may be incomplete, requiring future compensation

text.content: With astonishing willpower, Chen Ji maintained clarity amid the torrent, like a steady helmsman navigating treacherous waves. He precisely filtered useful information, absorbing everything related to the Tianji Record's core while temporarily sealing away those heavy memories and emotions.

dialogue.content: 'Your bloodline... is more compatible than I anticipated.' The Tianji Eye's voice carried rare astonishment. 'The Chen family truly is the favored one of Heavenly Fate. The layout from ten thousand years ago has finally reached the time of harvest.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt something awakening within him. That was the fusion of the Tianji Record Fragment and the inheritance's power, as well as some essence dormant in his bloodline for ten thousand years being roused. He saw countless possible futures for himself—each pointing toward the same endpoint: shattering this heavenly chess game.

Just as the inheritance was about to complete, Chen Ji's spiritual consciousness suddenly caught an anomaly. It was an extremely subtle fluctuation, yet it made his heart sink violently—as if something was observing from the shadows. And the Tianji Eye seemed to sense this anomaly too, its voice becoming more urgent.

choice.prompt: Crisis approaches. Chen Ji must react before the inheritance completes.

choices.description: Desperately accelerate the inheritance fusion, completing the breakthrough before being detected.
choices.visible_cost: May lead to unstable fusion, leaving hidden dangers
choices.visible_reward: Complete the inheritance before crisis arrives, gaining the upper hand

text.content: Chen Ji poured his entire spiritual consciousness into the inheritance, forcibly accelerating the fusion process in an almost self-destructive manner. That force scorched through his meridians like boiling magma. Though the process was extremely perilous, it allowed him to touch the threshold of the Heavenly Secrets realm in the shortest time.

choices.description: Temporarily interrupt the inheritance, first investigating the source of that anomalous fluctuation.
choices.visible_cost: Inheritance forced to interrupt, may miss the optimal timing
choices.visible_reward: Discover enemy traces early, gain initiative
choices.risk_hint: Steady but may miss the opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji displayed composure beyond ordinary people, forcefully dividing a strand of spiritual consciousness to investigate the fluctuation at the critical moment of inheritance. To his dread, the aura contained within that fluctuation bore some resemblance to the Tianji Eye, yet was more ancient, more... dangerous.

'There's no time to explain!' The Tianji Eye's voice showed urgency for the first time. 'It has sensed the anomaly—the existence within the twelve-thousand-year-old remnant is awakening! You must complete the inheritance immediately, or all will be lost!'

dialogue.content: 'Child, listen carefully.' The Tianji Eye's voice suddenly became extremely gentle. 'I have waited too long for this day. Twelve thousand years ago, that existence sealed its most core Heavenly Secrets power within this void, awaiting a true awakener.'

text.content: As the Tianji Eye's words fell, a brilliant light descended from the void, directly entering Chen Ji's brow center. That light contained something indescribable—the complete form of the Tianji Record never before revealed, the true power capable of glimpsing the river of destiny.

Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him trembling violently. Those originally incomplete bamboo slips were repairing at an astonishing rate. With each repair, his perception of the future grew clearer. Until at some point, he saw—he saw a calamity three days hence that could overturn the entire cultivation world.

In that moment, Chen Ji's realm broke through like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon. He rose from quasi-Heavenly Secrets to true Heavenly Secrets, his entire aura undergoing a qualitative transformation. The Tianji Record was no longer a fragmentary bamboo slip, but a complete silk scroll, its flowing patterns seeming to contain all the secrets between heaven and earth.

dialogue.content: Witnessing Chen Ji's transformation, an unprecedented emotional fluctuation appeared within the Tianji Eye's ancient consciousness—that was a smile, its first revealed in ten thousand years. 'Indeed, you have not disappointed me.' It said, 'From this day forward, you are the true Tianji Master.'

text.content: The instant the Tianji Eye's words fell, Chen Ji's spiritual consciousness suddenly tightened sharply. That sensation of being observed increased tenfold, as if some terrifying existence was approaching at an incomprehensible speed. He could even sense its aura—cold, ancient, filled with desire for destruction.

'Escape immediately!' The Tianji Eye's voice became extraordinarily urgent. 'That existence has completely awakened, it has detected your presence. With your current strength, you cannot contend with it head-on. You must leave here before it locks onto you!'

choice.prompt: Crisis looms imminent. Chen Ji must make a decision.

choices.description: Heed the Tianji Eye's warning, immediately leave this space.
choices.visible_cost: May leave tracking opportunities for the enemy

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest, rapidly passing through the passage the Tianji Eye opened for him. Behind him, that sensation of surveillance grew increasingly intense, as if something was frantically tearing through space, attempting to catch up to him. But he knew that as long as he returned to the outside world, he could once again hide behind thattrash facade.

choices.description: Before leaving, leave some kind of trump card, preparing for future confrontation with that existence.
choices.visible_cost: May allow that existence to trace more clues

text.content: As Chen Ji rapidly retreated, he used the Tianji Record's power to leave a covert mark in the space. That was a connection channel between him and the Tianji Eye, also a key trump card for future confrontation with that existence. Although it risked being traced, this move was worth it.

The moment Chen Ji returned from the void, he found himself standing in the ruins of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Everything seemed like merely a dream, yet the complete Tianji Record in his hand silently told him—this was all real. He had truly obtained an inheritance capable of changing destiny.

However, before Chen Ji could even heave a sigh of relief, a bone-piercing coldness crawled up his spine. That was not an external threat, but the Tianji Record itself issuing a warning—the awakened existence had already directed its gaze toward this realm. Chen Ji knew his time was running out. Three days, only three days remained.
